title.en: Localize editable-control labels without changing user input
title.zh: 本地化输入控件标签且不改动用户输入

purpose.en: Ensure Japanese, Korean, and other runtime locales translate textarea placeholders and accessible labels while preserving typed text.
purpose.zh: 确保日语、韩语及其他运行时语言会翻译文本框占位符和无障碍标签，同时保留用户输入。

en: Translate placeholder, aria-label, title, and alt attributes on textarea controls inserted after page load.
Keep editable textarea text and the twelve native language names excluded from automatic translation.
zh: 翻译页面载入后动态插入文本框的 placeholder、aria-label、title 和 alt 属性。
继续禁止自动翻译文本框文字和十二个语言母语名称。

en: Runtime-localized textareas on public, menu-linked, authentication, messaging, course, and game pages.
GreatLoveMeta Project release history and deployment verification.
zh: 公开页、菜单链接页、登录、消息、课程和游戏页面中的运行时本地化文本框。
GreatLoveMeta Project 发布历史和部署验证。

en: Separate editable text protection from control-attribute localization in the existing locale runtime.
Preserve GreatLoveMeta branding, native language names, user values, data, and cloud resources.
zh: 在现有语言运行时中分离可编辑文字保护与控件属性本地化。
保留 GreatLoveMeta 品牌、语言本名、用户输入值、数据和云资源。

en: Run the locale-input audit, targeted localization contracts, complete repository tests, production build, artifact checks, and shared gates.
Use one real Chrome tab to check Japanese and Korean home, language menu, authentication, and textarea input behavior.
zh: 执行输入本地化审计、定向本地化契约、完整仓库测试、生产构建、制品及共享门禁。
用一个真实 Chrome 标签检查日语与韩语首页、语言菜单、登录和文本框输入行为。

en: Full sign-in, games, swaps, and end-to-end course workflows are intentionally outside this fast migration check.
zh: 完整登录、游戏、兑换和端到端课程流程按快速迁移范围有意延后。

en: Preserve GreatLoveMeta branding, ecosystem destinations, independent data, and cloud resources while adopting true locale routing.
zh: 采用真实语言路由时，保留 GreatLoveMeta 的品牌、生态目的地、独立数据与云资源。
